unacceptable_risk.description: Prohibited practices under Article 5 (in force since Feb 2025).
examples: Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement (with narrow exceptions)
Emotion recognition in the workplace or education settings
Untargeted scraping of facial images to build recognition databases
Manipulative or subliminal techniques causing significant harm
Exploitation of vulnerabilities (age, disability, socio-economic situation)

high_risk.description: Annex III use cases — subject to conformity assessment, risk management, human oversight, logging, and technical documentation obligations.
examples: Recruitment: CV screening, candidate ranking, interview analysis
Employment: promotion/termination decisions, task allocation, performance monitoring
Essential public services eligibility (e.g., social benefits)

limited_risk.description: Transparency obligations only (Article 50) — must disclose AI interaction or generated/manipulated content.
examples: General-purpose chatbots without high-risk decision authority
Biometric categorization systems disclosed to users

minimal_risk.description: No specific obligations under the Act.

nist_ai_rmf_functions.GOVERN: Establish accountability structures, policies, and risk tolerance before/around the AI lifecycle.
nist_ai_rmf_functions.MAP: Establish context: identify the use case, stakeholders, and potential impacts/risks.
nist_ai_rmf_functions.MEASURE: Assess, benchmark, and monitor risks (bias testing, robustness, performance) with appropriate metrics.
nist_ai_rmf_functions.MANAGE: Prioritize and respond to risks; allocate resources; plan for incident response and decommissioning.

ny_local_law_144.description: Applies specifically to Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDTs) used by NYC employers to substantially assist or replace discretionary hiring/promotion decisions.
trigger_conditions: Tool is used to screen, score, or rank candidates for hiring or promotion
Tool's output is used to substantially assist or replace human decision-making (not merely one minor input among many)
Employer/employment agency is located in or hiring for a position in New York City
if_triggered_requires: Independent bias audit within the prior year
Public posting of a summary of the bias audit results
Disclosure of data retention/type collected upon request
